summary: FR-3 fix is correct and the new tests meaningfully exercise the defect paths. `generateArticleNew` now awaits `db.transaction`, the inner `Promise.all` of background generators is awaited, and multiple-choice rows with an answer not present in `options` are filtered out instead of being persisted with `correctAnswer: 0`. The primary-advantage test suite passes with the new tests included. Full-app `tsc --noEmit` still fails, but only on pre-existing type errors in files unchanged by this commit; no type errors were introduced in `new-generator.ts` or `new-generator.test.ts`.
nonblocking_findings: Full-app `pnpm --filter primary-advantage exec tsc --noEmit` fails with pre-existing type errors in unchanged files (`teacherModel.ts`, `userModel.ts`, `assistant.ts`, `image-generator.ts`, `sentence-translator.ts`, `story-generator.ts`). The changed files (`new-generator.ts`, `new-generator.test.ts`) produce no new type errors.

`persistGeneratedArticle` and its test cast the Drizzle transaction handle with `tx as never`, and `generateArticleNew` casts `convertCefrLevel`/`article` through `unknown`. These are unnecessary type-safety leaks; the seam should preserve the transaction type (e.g. `tx as unknown as TxLike`) rather than `as never`.
`PersistArticleInput` includes `ArticleType`, but `persistGeneratedArticle` uses the module-level `ArticleType` imported from `@/types/enum`. The injected parameter is currently unused.

`server/models/__tests__/fr11.behavior.test.ts` logs a Vitest mock error for a missing `schools` export during the full primary-advantage run, but the test file still passes; this is unrelated to FR-3.
The new test suite does not cover the `ArticleGenerationError` thrown when `generateImage` returns `{ success: false }` (implemented at `new-generator.ts:199-203`).
evidence: Commit d63c1831 refactors `apps/primary-advantage/server/utils/genaretors/new-generator.ts`: `generateArticleNew` now `await db.transaction(...)` (line 299), the transaction body is extracted to `persistGeneratedArticle`, and the inner `Promise.all([generateImage, generateAudio, generateAudioForFlashcard])` is awaited (line 193).

`persistGeneratedArticle` filters `article.multipleChoiceQuestions` to `validMcq` where `question.options.indexOf(question.answer) >= 0` (lines 169-172) and only persists those rows; skipped rows are logged with `console.warn` (lines 186-190).

`new-generator.test.ts` adds three behavioral assertions: (a) a broken MCQ row is not persisted, (b) an inner transaction rejection propagates to the caller, (c) the background generator `Promise.all` is awaited before the function resolves.
`pnpm --filter primary-advantage exec vitest run server/utils/genaretors/__tests__/new-generator.test.ts` passes: 3/3 tests green.
`pnpm --filter primary-advantage test` passes: 43/43 tests green across 4 test files.
`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0; `@reading-advantage/ai` is correctly declared as `workspace:*` in `apps/primary-advantage/package.json` and linked in `pnpm-lock.yaml`.

Git diff shows the type-error files (`teacherModel.ts`, `userModel.ts`, `assistant.ts`, `image-generator.ts`, `sentence-translator.ts`, `story-generator.ts`) were not modified by d63c1831, and `@reading-advantage/ai` package exports were not changed, so the reported tsc errors are pre-existing.
